body.summary: Loosen StoredPacketSchema.documents so story, lld, plan and issue are each optional DocumentSchema with no other key allowed, keeping PacketSchema, the checkpoint schema and the review-summary scope in step; parsePacket still checks every present document path.

A checkpoint and a review summary written before the change still decode and validate
The contracts, compatibility, admission and history tests in src/workflow/code-review/task-review/__tests__ pass unchanged
